# Project Instructions

## About this project
This is a marketing website for Monster Book, a physical card game.
The site's goal is to build excitement, explain how the game works,
and drive visitors to support the game on Kickstarter.

Always read `GAME.md` before making decisions about content, tone,
or card details. If something is missing or unclear, ask me instead
of inventing it.

## Tech stack
- Astro with plain CSS (no Tailwind or UI frameworks unless I ask)
- Static output only; no backend or database
- Node.js LTS; use npm for packages
- Keep dependencies minimal and tell me before adding any new one

## Project structure
- `src/pages/` for site pages
- `src/components/` for reusable pieces
- `src/data/cards.json` is the single source of truth for the card list
- `public/assets/` for images, logo, and downloadable PDFs

## Design rules
- Mobile-first; test layouts at 375px wide before desktop
- Brand colors: #FF6A00, #6A1B9A, #7ED321, #120B1A
- Fonts: 'Inter' for headings, 'Inter' for body text
- Keep a consistent look: define colors and spacing as CSS variables
  in one place and reuse them
- Meet WCAG AA contrast and give every image meaningful alt text

## Content rules
- Tone: [e.g., playful and friendly, clear for newcomers]
- Never change rules text or card text without asking me
- Don't invent reviews, testimonials, prices, release dates, or stats
- Use placeholder text clearly marked `TODO:` when content is missing

## How to work
- Make small, focused changes; one feature or fix at a time
- Before editing, briefly state your plan
- After editing, summarize what changed and which files were touched
- Don't refactor or restyle unrelated code
- Optimize images (web-sized, compressed) and lazy-load below-the-fold ones
- Don't put API keys or secrets in code; use environment variables
  and tell me how to set them up

## Definition of done
- Site builds without errors or warnings (`npm run build`)
- Works on mobile and desktop
- Has a page title, meta description, and social share tags
- No broken links or missing images
